Pediatric Bootcamp & P.I.P.S.™ Technique Certification

The Brain-First Approach to Pediatric Mastery

Three recorded sessions, on demand

Enroll

There is pediatric care. And then there is understanding the architecture behind it.

Since 2016, this flagship program has trained forward-thinking healthcare providers to see what others miss: the neurological patterns beneath posture, the compensation beneath behaviour, the oral function beneath airway, and the stress beneath adaptation.

This is not just education. It is a clinical upgrade. It is a lens shift. It is the difference between managing symptoms and shaping developmental trajectories.

This program is for providers who

  • Refuse to practice reactively
  • Want to understand the nervous system beneath pediatric presentation
  • Know oral function is more than feeding
  • Recognize posture as a neurological story
  • Want hands-on mastery with structural precision
  • Value collaboration over isolation
  • Are ready to elevate the standard of pediatric care

The experience

Three parts, recorded live, completed at your pace.

Part 1

Building Blocks

Pediatrics, Neuro 101 and the ABC of Pediatric Practice

Before technique comes understanding. This foundational module reorients your clinical thinking around brain development, neuroplasticity, stress physiology and early adaptation.

  • How fetal and infant brain development shapes lifelong patterns
  • Epigenetics and environmental influence
  • Serve-and-return and attachment neuroscience
  • The power of touch and somatosensory regulation
  • The 4 T's: Traumas, Thoughts, Toxins, Technology
  • The posture, airway and tongue relationship
  • Developmental milestones without rushing to label
  • Creating a pediatric practice environment families trust
Part 2

Pediatric Bootcamp

Structural Mastery from Infancy to Adolescence

This immersive intensive trains you to assess and integrate pediatric care at a high clinical level.

  • Complete pediatric history and neurological examination
  • Tonal and cranial assessment
  • Primitive reflex evaluation and integration strategies
  • Pediatric TMJD understanding
  • Postural compensation patterns
  • Adolescent neurological development
  • Case integration and care plan design
Part 3

P.I.P.S.™ Technique Certification

Pediatric Intraoral Palate Specific Technique

Created by Dr. Jenna Davis, DC, the P.I.P.S.™ Technique is a refined, clinically integrated intraoral approach designed to transform how providers assess and care for infants, children, and beyond. You will learn how oral dysfunction influences posture, breathing, primitive reflexes, vagal tone and neurodevelopment, and how to address it safely, precisely and within scope.

  • Identify tongue-tie, lip-tie, oral tension and oral dysfunction, beyond the obvious signs
  • Recognize subtle compensation patterns linked to tongue posture and oral tone
  • Assess and address pediatric TMJD and intraoral palate imbalances
  • Link oral dysfunction to posture, primitive reflexes, breathing mechanics and vagal tone
  • Apply specific intraoral and cranial techniques safely across age ranges
  • Integrate the top home exercises to decrease tension, improve function and reduce recurrence
  • Communicate and collaborate with dentists, IBCLCs, SLPs, pediatricians and other providers

Certification pathway

Certification is competency-based. Whether you attend in person or complete the program on demand, you will demonstrate clarity in assessment, safety in application and understanding of integration before certification is granted.

On-demand participants complete a live Zoom review call with Dr. Jenna Davis to ensure proficiency and confidence in implementation.

Pricing

$1,295 USDEnroll

Who is eligible

The Pediatric Bootcamp and P.I.P.S.™ Certification is open to regulated healthcare providers whose scope permits pediatric hands-on assessment techniques.

Building Blocks (Part 1) is open to a broader range of regulated providers, including IBCLCs and SLPs.

Taught by

Dr. Jenna Davis

Family chiropractor, international speaker and educator based in Oakville, Ontario, and the creator of the P.I.P.S.™ Technique. The program is taught directly by the technique's creator.

About Dr. Jenna
